controls: Application multichannel ingest and ASR isolation run for 2, 3 and 8 channels while preserving channel order and source-time alignment.
One-channel end-to-end transcription is covered independently and begins with role unknown/unconfirmed.
Every isolated channel output binds to the original audio digest, its own PCM digest, channel index/count and exact shared sample-frame mapping.
Physical channel index is never treated as a clinician or patient identity; roles require explicit human review.
The ninth channel and a failed channel are rejected without publishing partial output.

local_checks.focused_tests: channel integration did not complete under local Windows TestClient; exact-source GitHub CI passed

limitations: Generated distinct channels establish transport and software behavior only; they are not multi-microphone hardware validation or speaker accuracy evidence.
